overviewParagraphs: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram Strip is Vietnam's uncontested champion — a Greg Norman masterpiece that has been ranked in Golf Digest's Top 100 Courses in the World. Sitting on a remote stretch of Vietnam's southern coastline, the course tumbles through enormous coastal sand dunes unlike anything else in Asia.

Norman himself calls it his favourite design. The layout exploits the natural terrain with relentless creativity: blind tee shots over dune ridges, platform greens carved into clifftops, and sweeping fairways that shift direction with the ocean breeze. It is physically and mentally the most demanding course in Vietnam.

Despite its remote location, the Ho Tram Strip resort provides five-star accommodation and a private airstrip for charter access. For the serious discerning golfer, The Bluffs is the defining Vietnam experience and a bucket-list course by any global standard.

curatorBriefHtml: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram is a premier Par 71 championship layout in Ho Tram, Vietnam, crafted by Greg Norman (2014) and stretching to 7,207 Yards across a parkland environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its clifftop sand dune elevation & ocean views (50m elevation shifts above sea) and fierce coastal wind exposure (Authentic linksland gale test).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its true firm links ground conditions (Fast running Zeon Zoysia), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Ho Tram golf tour by AGS, The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram provides a distinct architectural test by Greg Norman that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram?
faqs.a: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram in Ho Tram, Vietnam is a Par 71 championship layout designed by Greg Norman (opened 2014), measuring 7,207 Yards within a parkland setting. It is particularly noted for clifftop sand dune elevation & ocean views (50m elevation shifts above sea).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram?
faqs.a: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram operates under resort & visitor access via ags protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (true firm links ground conditions (Fast running Zeon Zoysia)), and private VIP transfers from your Ho Tram hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram's fierce coastal wind exposure (Authentic linksland gale test) alongside clifftop sand dune elevation & ocean views (50m elevation shifts above sea). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram?
faqs.a: November through April is prime season for The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram.
